command: cargo build --release -p sim-benchmark --features viability --example population-semantics; target/release/examples/population-semantics.exe; node scripts/population-semantics.mjs <output>

review.definitions: Post-warmup windows only. A counterfactual species candidate is a group with >=8 members and >=8 births involving it whose cross-group births are <=20% (unchanged threshold), whose centroid is >=100 genome distance from another concurrent group with >=8 members, in >=2 consecutive 1000-tick windows under the same group id. The same rule is applied to every semantic; no species are created. Same-niche: same mouth and lifetime diet role, morphology distance <150, genome distance <100.

decision: No grouping semantic yields an isolated, divergent population; current species gate kept unchanged; no authoritative candidate run.
executable_note: Rebuilt after a type-alias-only clippy fix; its output is byte-identical to the archived JSON.
